sanity_plan.note: Bounded write/read verification only; no pattern comparison or GC sweep

plan.purpose: Small initial-history control; reuse archived one-pass seed 42 and run only three-pass history
plan.fill_definition: live mapped bytes / exposed logical capacity; first contiguous region
plan.fio_compatibility: fio 3.36 uniform is the default random distribution; do not pass unsupported random_distribution=uniform
plan.gate: Before any measurement, preconditioning gc-write-pages and block-erases must both increase; otherwise stop unchanged and report
plan.interpretation: Operational plateau, not proof of infinite-horizon stationarity or hardware validity

convergence.estimator: ratio of sums in final 3 windows per run; mean and sample SD across three independent fresh-process replicates

plan.continuity_note: Preserve all original measurement subwindow commands/seeds. Three preconditioning passes repeat exactly the same seed 20261007; compare the same measurement horizon.

comparison.interpretation: Descriptive selected-history control with one run per pattern, not a statistical equivalence test
